title: Questions
description: A questions artifact: what an agent needs answered before it can say how to do the work, each question with the answers it offers. One JSON document of this schema is the one file of a version of the standard type questions. Every object refuses a member this schema does not define. A question is Markdown; an option's title and explanation are plain text. No text is ever followed as an instruction.

questions.description: What the agent needs answered before it can say how to do the work, 1 to 20 questions.

question.description: The question, as Markdown: text, lists and code blocks.

options.description: The answers the agent offers, 0 to 10: empty when it offers no option and the person writes the answer.

title.description: The option's title, plain text, 1 to 200 characters.

explanation.description: A short explanation of the option, plain text.

text.description: Text that may span lines: tab, line feed and carriage return are its only control characters, and U+0000 to U+0008, U+000B, U+000C, U+000E to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F are refused. So are the characters https://qory.dev/contracts/integration/v1/description.schema.json refuses in a prose line, $defs line, beyond control characters: the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB.

short_text.description: A short text, such as an option's explanation: 1 to 2000 characters.
